cards.subject: a calm, airy, botanical nursery for a baby under 2 years
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor. A low round quilted oat-and-blush play mat with a small natural-wood baby play gym lies in the middle of the floor, with one soft cream rabbit sitting on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a small potted trailing plant on a low white-washed oak stool, and above it two small framed botanical line prints. Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the RIGHT and lies evenly on the floor. A young mother in a soft oat knit cardigan and light linen trousers kneels on the play mat with her back to the camera, one hand resting on the play gym, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: soft lilac, blush, ivory, pale eucalyptus green and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a playful but soft room for a girl aged 2 to 5
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A plush cream dot rug lies on the floor, with one flower-shaped blush velvet bolster pillow on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low arch-shaped blush bookshelf with a few picture books and two round lilac floor poufs (everything under 70 cm), and above it two small scalloped picture frames with soft pastel abstract art. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the LEFT make soft dappled shadows on the floor. A small girl of about four in a blush knit sweater and cream trousers stands beside the lilac poufs with her back to the camera, one hand on the top pouf, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: pastel lilac, blush pink, butter cream and light oak.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A young mother in a soft oat knit cardigan and light linen trousers slowly reaches out, lifts the soft rabbit from the mat and holds it up in front of her. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. She stays on the RIGHT side of the frame, far from the misty mountains and the pine forest, and never passes in front of the mural. The soft light stays constant.
